name: audit-latest-baseline-current
command: python3 -c 'import json,subprocess,sys; r=subprocess.run(["git","fetch","origin","master"],capture_output=True,text=True); print("Remote baseline fetch "+("succeeded" if r.returncode==0 else "failed")); sys.exit(r.returncode) if r.returncode else None; out=lambda *a: subprocess.check_output(["git",*a],text=True).strip(); print(json.dumps({"aheadBehind":out("rev-list","--left-right","--count","HEAD...origin/master"),"sourceTree":out("rev-parse","HEAD^{tree}"),"originTree":out("rev-parse","origin/master^{tree}")}))'
